non_hardware_tests.name: import_boundary_test
non_hardware_tests.description: Verify import calibration_skill succeeds without Booster SDK; verify adapters/booster_k1 import fails gracefully without SDK

non_hardware_tests.name: adapter_factory_test
non_hardware_tests.description: Verify K1 adapter factory creates RobotAdapter instance; verify dry_run=True works without SDK

non_hardware_tests.name: command_mapping_test
non_hardware_tests.description: Verify VelocityCommand maps to legacy command parameters; verify duration/hz computation

non_hardware_tests.name: fake_booster_sdk_test
non_hardware_tests.description: Create fake/mock Booster SDK classes; verify adapter calls correct methods in correct order

non_hardware_tests.name: telemetry_normalization_test
non_hardware_tests.description: Feed recorded telemetry CSV through normalization; verify TelemetrySample invariants

non_hardware_tests.name: no_vendor_install_test
non_hardware_tests.description: Verify pip install calibration-skill (without [booster_k1] extra) does not pull Booster SDK; verify core imports work

non_hardware_tests.name: adapter_registry_k1_not_registered_test
non_hardware_tests.description: Verify K1 factory is NOT auto-registered; registration must be explicit and gated

non_hardware_tests.name: safety_envelope_no_silent_default_test
non_hardware_tests.description: Verify SafetyEnvelope construction requires explicit max values; no default to unlimited

non_hardware_tests.name: connection_config_no_auto_connect_test
non_hardware_tests.description: Verify ConnectionConfig construction does not trigger network activity or SDK import

non_hardware_tests.name: operator_authorization_expiry_test
non_hardware_tests.description: Verify expired OperatorAuthorization rejects commands; verify expiry check on each operation

hardware_gated_tests.name: k1_connection_preflight
hardware_gated_tests.description: Connect to real K1 on robot network; verify ConnectionState transitions; verify preflight passes
hardware_gated_tests.hardware_requirements: Booster K1 robot on network; SDK environment; operator present

hardware_gated_tests.name: k1_lifecycle_transition
hardware_gated_tests.hardware_requirements: Booster K1 robot; SDK environment; operator present; clear floor area

hardware_gated_tests.name: k1_bounded_velocity_command
hardware_gated_tests.description: Send velocity command within SafetyEnvelope (e.g., 0.40 m/s); verify CommandReceipt; verify telemetry captures motion
hardware_gated_tests.hardware_requirements: Booster K1 robot; SDK environment; ROS2 telemetry; operator present; clear floor area

hardware_gated_tests.name: k1_stop_acknowledgement
hardware_gated_tests.description: Send stop command during motion; verify robot stops; verify CommandReceipt with stopped disposition
hardware_gated_tests.hardware_requirements: Booster K1 robot; SDK environment; operator present; clear floor area

hardware_gated_tests.name: k1_telemetry_sample_capture
hardware_gated_tests.description: Capture live telemetry during command; verify TelemetrySample fields populated; verify timestamps monotonically increasing
hardware_gated_tests.hardware_requirements: Booster K1 robot; ROS2 telemetry active; odometer publishing

hardware_gated_tests.name: k1_safety_rejection
hardware_gated_tests.description: Attempt command exceeding SafetyEnvelope; verify rejection before any motion
hardware_gated_tests.hardware_requirements: Booster K1 robot; SDK environment; operator present

hardware_gated_tests.name: k1_emergency_stop
hardware_gated_tests.description: Execute emergency stop during motion; verify immediate stop; verify robot enters safe state
hardware_gated_tests.hardware_requirements: Booster K1 robot; SDK environment; operator present; clear floor area; emergency stop procedure defined

hardware_gated_tests.name: k1_audit_package_generation
hardware_gated_tests.description: Execute trial; verify ExecutionAuditRecord contains receipt, telemetry window, safety envelope, authorization
hardware_gated_tests.hardware_requirements: Booster K1 robot; full test infrastructure

ci_policy.rule: ALL hardware_gated_tests MUST be excluded from CI
